Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the run chase. Wesley Madhevere and Tadiwanashe Marumani will open for Zimbabwe and Taskin Ahmed will start the proceedings for Bangladesh. Here we go...

Right then! Zimbabwe have 277 in front of them to chase. They will certainly need a big knock from one of their batsmen to help achieve that. Meanwhile, Bangladesh will aim for early wickets. Join us in a while for an interesting run-chase.

Blessing Muzarabani and Tendai Chatara opened the attack and were off to a flying start. They didn't allow the Bangladeshi's openers to settle. Both of them managed to keep Bangladesh at bay. The openers were beaten on the outside edge on numerous occasions but to no avail. But soon, Muzarabani drew the first blood removing Tamim Iqbal for a duck. He got the prized wicket of Shakib Al Hasan as well. Only 38 runs were conceded inside the first Powerplay at the cost of 2 wickets. Chatara continued with his probing line and lengths and finally got his reward scalping the wicket of Mithun. Ngarava then removed Mossadek Hossain. Just when things started to look good for Zimbabwe, Liton Das and Mahumudullah took the game away from them till the 36th over as Mahmudullah fell to Luke Jongwe. Das's stay too came to end as Ngarava removed him soon after he brought up his century. Luke Jongwe was the pick of the bowlers as he conceded 51 runs and picked up 3 wickets in his nine overs. Zimbabwe bowlers conceded too many runs in the last 10 overs and that will hurt them especially after a splendid start. Zimbabwe now have 277 to chase.

Bangladesh were off to a nervy start as they lost Tamim Iqbal for a duck. Shakib Al Hasan too didn't look comfortable at the crease and departed soon. Mohammad Mithun came in and knocked a few boundaries. After that, he ran out of patience and threw his wicket in frustration for run a ball 19. After losing Mossadek Hossain, Liton Das and Mahmudullah joined hands once again and provided the partnership that Bangladesh were looking for. The duo stitched an important partnership of 93 runs for the fifth wicket. Both the batters kept the scoreboard ticking and allowed the runs to keep flowing. Later, Mahumudullah fell to Jongwe but Das stayed at the crease. Just when he started to shift gears and brought up his 4th ODI century. But immediately fell to Ngarava looking to up the ante. Afif Hossain with the support of Mehidy Hasan built a 58-run partnership towards the end and that has helped Bangladesh to put a total of 276 on the board.
Two is the call and he gets it comfortably! A full ball, on middle. Mohammad Saifuddin eases it to mid-wicket and takes a couple of runs. BANGLADESH END AT 276 FOR 9.
A full toss, around off. Saifuddin misses his flick. Richard Ngarava lonely appeals but turned down.

FOUR! Good shot from Mohammad Saifuddin! A full ball, outside off. Saifuddin leans into his drive and creams it through covers for a boundary.

Good length ball, on off. Islam pushes it to covers. What a brilliant over from Luke Jongwe.

OUT! RUN OUT! Such a turnaround in the game! Fuller around off, flicked towards mid-wicket. Taskin Ahmed gets back for the second run but is too casual in his running. Wellington Masakadza collects the ball and throws it to Regis Chakabva. The throw is a little wild and he runs ahead to collect it. Brilliant presence of mind from him as he flicks the ball to stumps after collecting. A no-look flick and that has caught Taskin Ahmed short of the crease. No hat-trick for Luke Jongwe but a team hat-trick for Zimbabwe.
Commentary.Howout: run out (sub Wellington Masakadza / Regis Chakabva)

Drinks! Mahmudullah and Das have steadied the ship but they would look to change the gears from now on. For Zimbabwe, they are in a good position but will have to take wickets at regular intervals to keep Bangladesh on the back foot.

Needless form Hossain and he departs. Bangladesh in deep trouble.
Commentary.Howout: c Regis Chakabva b Richard Ngarava

Drinks! Zimbabwe have been right on the money so far. They have not allowed the batsman to settle in and have got three big wickets. Their bowlers have done a terrific job by executing their lines and lengths perfectly. For Bangladesh, Liton Das and Mosaddek Hossain have to try and rotate the strike more and will need a partnership to solidify their innings. Luke Jongwe is into the attack as he replaces Tendai Chatara.

A length ball, on off. Defended solidly.
Mohammad Mithun is the new batsman to walk out in the middle.

OUT! CAUGHT! This is a big wicket for Zimbabwe and they have got the big fish cheaply! Shakib Al Hasan is disappointed with his shot! A back of a length ball, angling across, outside off. Al Hasan looks to slap it uppishly but does with the bottom part of his blade. Hits it straight in the hands of Ryan Burl, who takes a wonderful catch by diving forward at point.
Commentary.Howout: c Ryan Burl b Blessing Muzarabani

Commentary.Commentary: A length ball, outside off. Das works it on the off side for a single.
SWING AND A MISS! A full ball, slanting across, outside off. Al Hasan slashes at it but misses. Chatara optimistically appeals but not given.
Serves a full ball, on off. Das pushes it wide of covers for a single.
Good length delivery, on the pads, clipped away on the leg side for one run.
On a length, on middle. Al Hasan blocks it out.
EDGY FOUR! A short ball, outside off. Shakib Al Hasan looks to slice it but mistimes it. The ball takes off the outside edge and flies to the third man region for a boundary.
Beauty of a delivery from Tendai Chatara! A good length ball, around off, shapes away from the batter. Shakib Al Hasan looks to defend but gets squared up and gets beaten on the outside edge.
A full ball, around off. Das leans forward to drive but finds the fielder at covers.
A short ball, outside off. Das rides it over point for a couple of runs.
Outside off. This is dabbed away to third man for one.
Length ball, on middle. Al Hasan blocks it out.

Good bowling from Blessing Muzarabani, he is mixing up his lengths and not allowing the Bangladeshi batsman to settle in! A back of a length ball, way down the leg side. Shakib Al Hasan looks to flick but seems to get thigh pad on its way to the keeper.
A good length ball, around middle. Das blocks it out on the leg side and runs across for a quick single.
A length ball, outside off. Shakib Al Hasan cuts it past point. The third man fielder comes across and cuts it off. Two taken.
FOUR! Slapped away! This will release some pressure off! A length ball, way outside off. Shakib Al Hasan slaps it through cover-point for a boundary.
A full ball, on off. Pushed to covers.
On middle. Another solid defense from Shakib Al Hasan.
A good length ball, on middle. Shakib Al Hasan defends it to covers.
TWO WIDES! A back of a length ball, around leg.  Das looks to flick but misses. The keeper dives to his left and gets some gloves on it. Single taken.
A good length ball, on off. Das hops and blocks it out.
Length delivery on off, defended back to the bowler. Another maiden for Blessing Muzarabani.
Length ball on off, angling away, Al Hasan pushes it to mid off.
Full and on off, Al Hasan pushes it to point.
Length ball on off, Al Hasan taps it to point.
On a length on off, Al Hasan blocks it out.
Good length delivery on off, Al Hasan looks to cut it but misses. It is the same ball that got Iqbal out.
Dot to end the over! A touch fuller ball on middle. Das defends it out.
Another fuller length delivery, on middle. Blocked out solidlly.
Another full ball, around off. Shakib Al Hasan reaches to the pitch of the ball, checks his shot and drives it uppishly towards mid off.
A full ball, around off. Das pushes it to covers and scampers across for a single.
A good length ball, on off. Das blocks it out.
Length ball on middle, Al Hasan clips it to the leg side for one.
FIVE WIDES! Back of a length ball down the leg side, Shakib leaves it alone. Chakabva tries his best to reach it out and take it but fails. The ball goes past him to the fine leg fence. Bonus runs.
A full ball, on off. Das lunges forward to defend it out. Another good over from Blessing Muzarabani, getting the big wicket of Tamim Iqbal.
A good length ball, outside off. Das shoulders arms to it.
Serves a full length ball, on off. Shakib Al Hasan drives it straightly. It hits the stumps on the other end and ricochets it wide of mid on. Single taken.
Another full ball, on off. Shakib Al Hasan pushes it back to the bowler.
FOUR! Boundary to get of the mark for Shakib Al Hasan and Bangladesh! A full ball, aroundoff. Shakib Al Hasan prods forward and pushes it wide of mid on for a boundary.
Shakib Al Hasan walks out to bat at No.3.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! An early strike for Zimbabwe! Good length delivery on off, nipping away. The ball shoots up after hitting the deck. Tamim Iqbal is tempted to play the cut. He latches out on it and swings his blade. But the extra bounce works in the favor of Muzarabani. The ball takes the outside edge and carries to Regis Chakabva. A regulation catch for him. Big blow for Bangladesh. They lose their skipper for a duck. Tamim Iqbal walks back to the shed disappointed. Blessing Muzarabani draws the first blood and is delighted.
Commentary.Howout: c Regis Chakabva b Blessing Muzarabani

Commentary.Commentary: Full and on middle, Das defends it down on the deck. Still no runs for Bangladesh. They are struggling against the new ball here. Two maidens in a row for Zimbabwe!
No run. On off, Das taps it to point.
Jaffa! Good length delivery on off, nipping away, Das is beaten by the pace and swing. Was whisker away kissing the outside edge.
On a length on off, Das defends it well.
Length ball outside off, Das lets it for the keeper to collect.
On a length on off, nipping away, Das looks to defend but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Who will bowl from the other end? It is Tendai Chatara.
Excellent start for Zimbabwe! On a length on off, Iqbal looks to defend but misses. The ball zips past the outside edge into the keeper's mitts. A maiden for Muzarabani.
Absolute beauty! Good length delivery around off, Iqbal looks to defend but beats the outside edge. Muzarabani will be looking to bowl in that channel.
Back of a length delivery on off, Iqbal hops and blocks it out to point.
Full length delivery on off, Iqbal defends it off the front foot towards mid off.
Good length ball outside off, Iqbal lets it sail through as he shoulders arms.
Nice channel! Serves a good length delivery on off, nipping away, Iqbal lets it be.

We are set to begin! Zimbabwe players form a huddle and now disperse out on the field to take their respective positions. Tamim Iqbal and Liton Das will open the innings for Bangladesh. Blessing Muzarabani to start with the ball.

Bangladesh (Playing XI) - Tamim Iqbal (C), Liton Das (WK), Mohammad Mithun, Mosaddek Hossain, Shakib Al Hasan, Mahmudullah, Mehidy Hasan, Mohammad Saifuddin, Afif Hossain, Taskin Ahmed, Shoriful Islam.

Zimbabwe (Playing XI) - Wesley Madhevere, Tadiwanashe Marumani, Brendan Taylor (C), Dion Myers, Timycen Maruma, Regis Chakabva (WK), Ryan Burl, Luke Jongwe, Tendai Chatara, Blessing Muzarabani, Richard Ngarava.
TOSS time at Harare! Up goes the coin and lands in the favor of Zimbabwe. They have elected to BOWL first.

Hello and a warm welcome to the first ODI between Zimbabwe and Bangladesh. Bangladesh are on a 16-match winning streak against Zimbabwe. They will start as favorites. After losing the one-off Test, Zimbabwe would look for some retreat by making a mark in the ODIs. Will Bangladesh extend their streak? Or are we in for a surprise? Let's find out. Toss and lineups in a bit.
